author: claude-code
rationale: Two live themes, and they are not independent. First, a hawkish repricing: Hammack says policy is not restrictive and it is time to hike, Sahm has flipped to hikes and says she is no longer confident inflation returns to 2%, and August payrolls printed 162K against 55K expected with the prior revised from -23K to +21K. Second, an oil supply threat: crude above $100 with a reported US strike on a tanker near Kharg Island, which handles the large majority of Iranian exports. The tilts below are mostly one bet expressed four ways -- rates up -- so the diversification is smaller than four names suggests, and sizing is deliberately modest. Working against all of it: this is public and a day old, the market moved on it, and Trump is publicly pressuring for cuts, which makes the rate path two-sided in a way a purely economic read would miss. Nothing here is a high-conviction call.
notes: Declined to tilt IWM despite small caps being rate-sensitive: hawkish policy raises their funding costs but the same strong labour data supports their earnings, so the mechanism cuts both ways and nets to no view. Also declined on the Russia-Ukraine de-escalation headlines, which point the opposite way on energy to the Iran escalation and are too early to size.

adjustments.reason: Hike expectations transmit to long yields, and long-duration bonds fall mechanically as yields rise. This is the most direct expression of the repricing and the shortest causal chain of any tilt here.
adjustments.evidence: Hammack says now is the time to hike; Sahm calls a hike appropriate policy; 162K payrolls vs 55K est

adjustments.reason: Utilities trade as a bond proxy on their dividend yield, so rising long yields compress relative valuation. Second-order to the TLT tilt and correlated with it, hence the smaller size.
adjustments.evidence: Rising Vacancies and Falling Payrolls Box in the Fed

adjustments.reason: Higher policy rates widen net interest margins for banks, the one sector where a hawkish path is a revenue tailwind rather than a discount-rate headwind.
adjustments.evidence: The US Jobs Report Hid a Rate-Trade Clue. These ETFs Could Be Ready to Run

adjustments.reason: A strike near Kharg Island threatens the terminal handling most Iranian seaborne exports, and sustained crude above $100 flows through to energy sector revenue and margins. Shorter expiry than the rate tilts because supply scares decay fast when the disruption does not materialise.
adjustments.evidence: Iranian tanker targeted four miles from Kharg Island; Oil Tops $100

author: claude-code
rationale: One theme, three expressions, and I want that stated up front rather than dressed as diversification: every tilt below is a bet that the AI capex cycle keeps running, and if it stalls all three fail together. Susquehanna arguing memory has passed 50 percent of semiconductor revenue is a structural claim rather than a price target, and SK Hynix surging is independent confirmation from a comparable. Broadcom has locked supply through 2027 and is working on 2028 while shifting capital allocation toward buybacks, which is a concrete change in both revenue visibility and share count. Microsoft breaking Azure out at 100 billion annualised lets the market value that segment directly instead of inside a conglomerate. All three are public and partly priced -- the case for acting is that structural re-ratings play out over weeks rather than in a session, not that anyone has missed the news.
notes: Declined AAPL despite it dominating the week by article count. An Apple launch is the most anticipated event in equities, the stock had already risen on the day, and betting the sell-the-news pattern means betting against a genuinely new form factor at a premium price. Anticipation that complete leaves no room for interpretation to add anything. Declined INTC, which had already jumped 10 percent on the Terafab story -- that is a reaction, and the move is the thing I would be chasing. Declined NVDA on the China cybersecurity friction: real, but a running story for years and well understood, so no fresh mechanism.

adjustments.reason: If memory really has taken over half of semiconductor revenue, pricing power flows to the pure-play memory maker through both revenue and margin. SK Hynix moving on the same read is confirmation from a peer rather than a second opinion on the same stock.
adjustments.evidence: Memory Is the New King of Chips, Taking Over 50% of Semiconductor Revenue, Susquehanna Says; Why Is SK Hynix Stock Surging

adjustments.reason: Two mechanisms at once: supply locked through 2027 and being locked for 2028 removes a revenue risk that peers still carry, and a stated shift toward buybacks reduces share count while signalling management confidence in cash generation.
adjustments.evidence: Broadcom CEO says can lock in chip supply for 2027, in process of locking in 2028; capital allocation likely to focus on increased dividends, stock buybacks

adjustments.reason: A segment breakout is a disclosure change, not a business change, but it lets the market value Azure on its own multiple rather than inside the whole. Lowest confidence of the three because Microsoft is the most heavily covered name here and the least likely to hold an unread fact.
adjustments.evidence: Microsoft Breaks Out Azure Sales at $100 Billion Annualized Pace, Reorganizes AI Segments
